attempted_claim: Fix beta_*=3*pi/2 and the standard smoothly bounded worm W_{beta_*} in C^2 with boundary bW_{beta_*} carrying induced surface measure, Hardy space H^2(bW_{beta_*}), and Szego projection S_*. Prove or disprove: S_* extends to a bounded operator W^{1,2}(bW_{beta_*})->W^{1,2}(bW_{beta_*}) on boundary L^2-Sobolev space of order 1. A complete proof gives an explicit operator bound via a boundary-kernel estimate with Levi-flat-annulus contribution ledger; a complete disproof exhibits one explicit boundary function f in W^{1,2} (rotation-mode coefficient concentrating near the annulus, with tabulated Sobolev-norm ledger) whose Szego projection S_*f is rigorously outside W^{1,2}.
decisive_failure: The lane established sharp model-boundary facts (nu=1/2, threshold 1/4 at beta*=3pi/2) with a verified numeric ledger, but could not close the smooth-worm W^{1,2} boundedness question because the Szego kernel and model-to-smooth transfer at the infinite-type annulus are unavailable in the literature and were explicitly flagged open.
